NEOW.talk.ALLIES.0-1.char: The Allied Forces never falter. We will overcome any obstacle in our path.
NEOW.talk.ALLIES.1-1.char: Every battle teaches us. Every defeat strengthens us. We are the Allies.
NEOW.talk.ALLIES.2-1.char: Resilience? This is merely our standard operating procedure.
NEOW.talk.SOVIET.0-1.char: The Soviet Union does not ask if it can endure - it demands victory!
NEOW.talk.SOVIET.1-1.char: Soviet forces never retreat. Every battle brings us closer to triumph.
NEOW.talk.SOVIET.2-1.char: Unbreakable? This is the spirit of the Soviet Union!
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.RED_ALERT2_MOD_CHARAC: [red]Allied Forces[/red]. Your technology is impressive, but it cannot save you from the inevitable collapse.
Respond
Inevitable? The Allies always find a way. Our ingenuity knows no bounds!
Continue
Ingenuity without purpose is just noise.
Continue
Our purpose is clear: to bring order and freedom to the world!
[red]Allied Forces[/red], you cling to your technology like a child clings to a toy.
Respond
Technology is our tool, not our crutch. And we know how to use it.
Continue
Then prove it. Show me what your 'tools' can do.
Continue
Our ingenuity knows no bounds!
[red]Allied Forces[/red], your persistence is... unexpected.
Respond
Unexpected? This is what the Allies do. We adapt, we overcome, we win.
Continue
We shall see if your victory extends to the tower's summit.
Continue
We shall see whose tactics prevail.
[red]Allied Forces[/red], you have come far... but the last step is the most critical.
Respond
We are prepared. No matter what lies ahead, the Allies will not retreat.
Continue
Then let me see if your resolve is sufficient to win the final victory.
Continue
We are willing to give everything for victory. The glory of the Allies shall never be extinguished!
[red]Allied Forces[/red]... you made it here... impressive.
Respond
We didn't just make it here — we fought our way through.
Continue
Then prove your worth. Let me see if you deserve the glory at the tower's summit.
Continue
We deserve it! The Allies will prove our wisdom, our courage, our determination!
[red]Allied Forces[/red]... again... you surprise me.
Respond
Surprise? We simply advance the Allied way — adapt, overcome, win.
Continue
The glory at the tower's summit is within reach. Prove you deserve it.
Continue
We don't just deserve it — we are the glory itself!
[red]Allied Forces[/red]... you've reached new heights... let me see if you are worthy of standing at the tower's summit.
Respond
Worthy? We earned the right to stand here with wisdom, courage, and determination!
Continue
Then the final test comes. Prove you are not just a pretender.
Continue
A pretender? Let's see who the true legend is!
[red]Soviet Union[/red]. Your brute force will shatter against the tower's defenses.
Respond
Brute force? This is the might of the Soviet people! We will crush all who oppose us!
Continue
Arrogance is not strength.
Continue
Then let us see who is truly strong!
[red]Soviet Union[/red], your firepower is impressive, but it lacks precision.
Respond
Precision? We have something better - overwhelming force!
Continue
Force without direction is chaos.
Continue
Force without direction is chaos... but the Red Army will find its direction!
Continue
[red]Soviet Union[/red], your determination is... admirable, in its own way.
Respond
Admirable? We do not seek admiration. We seek victory!
Continue
Then climb. Prove your worth at the tower's summit.
